profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
As a Senior Software Engineer, I leverage my 7+ years of experience and expertise in web technologies to develop and maintain high-performance web applications. I have worked with multiple Agile engineering teams, following best practices and standards for code quality, testing, and deployment.

My passion for the web drives me to create user-friendly and engaging UIs that meet the needs and expectations of diverse audiences and clients. I enjoy collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to deliver innovative and scalable web solutions that support a company's growth and success.

positions.title: Front-End Developer
positions.description:
Responsibilities included: 
• Converting mockups received from the UX/design team into fully functioning HTML, CSS/LESS, and JavaScript code.
• Reviewing code submitted by other Front End Development team members to ensure code quality and consistency prior to merging.
• Building and maintaining the front end component library which provided working examples and documentation of Angular directives for both the UX and Development teams.
• Participating in UX reviews and providing feedback on design proposals from a front end development perspective.
